title: Stationary Strings Theorem VI: Dirac-Majorana Chiral Peeling in Navier-Stokes Vortex Blowup, the Meral Baryogenesis Constant, and CERN ALPHA / 511 keV Observational Synthesis
description: Sixth link of the series (October 2026): Dirac-Majorana chiral peeling in vortex shear (Test T13), the Meral baryogenesis constant with closed analytic form (Test T14), CERN ALPHA-g / ALPHA 2026 Breit-Rabi / 511 keV verification (Test T15). Full paper in Turkish and English. Tests T13-T15 run with the solver in the Paper V repository (stationary-strings-v, tag v3).
